annotations.title: Web answer, AI with citations: answer a question from live search results

description: Answer a question from the live web in one call: a Brave web search, the top result pages read, and an answer written by Llama 4 Scout from those sources only, with inline [n] citations and the source list (title, URL). Says so when the sources do not answer it. Results are for the caller's immediate use only: no storing, resale or model training (Brave API terms). Use when an agent needs a current, sourced answer rather than raw search results. Example: q=What is the x402 payment protocol?. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
